info.name: Plaid Create a new Identity Verification

items.docs:
Create a new Identity Verification for the user specified by the `client_user_id` field. The requirements and behavior of the verification are determined by the `template_id` provided.
If you don't know whether the associated user already has an active Identity Verification, you can specify `"is_idempotent": true` in the request body.
